result.title: MS-Point: Multi-Modal Hierarchical Spectral Learning for Point Cloud Understanding
result.summary: Point-image alignment learns useful object representations, but different local feature patterns can produce the same pooled descriptor and receive the same alignment signal. We introduce MS-Point, a cross-modal pretraining framework that directly supervises intermediate point features and their neighborhood responses. At selected encoder stages, we compute neighborhood averages and residuals before pooling and align their branch descriptors with image features. Branch-level objectives align each representation with its visual target, while cross-level consistency and adaptive fusion coordinate information across branches. A common interface of intermediate features and spatial neighborhoods supports both graph encoders and point Transformers. Evaluations across object classification, few-shot adaptation, dense prediction, and low-label scene learning demonstrate the transfer value of this design. Same-backbone comparisons and capacity-matched and computation-matched controls connect these improvements to the structure of supervision. Together, our findings support directly supervising intermediate features and neighborhood variation to learn transferable, geometry-aware representations across modalities.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MS-Point 跨模态预训练框架，指出不同局部特征模式经池化后会得到相同描述子并收到相同对齐信号，因此在编码器若干阶段先计算邻域均值与残差，将各分支描述子与图像特征分别对齐，并辅以跨层一致性与自适应融合，在分类、少样本、稠密预测和低标签场景上验证迁移效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对「池化导致局部信息坍缩」的针对性监督线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节写入 latent 后被压缩丢失的问题，但任务为点云-图像对齐，是否约束推理期状态仍需读原文确认。
